pages: Added a responsive welcome screen with a faded Tutorial Village background, contributor links and a prominent Open ROM button.
Aligned commands, dialogue, comments and highlighting with a shared monospaced font and corrected placeholder spacing.
Made tutorial cards readable on hover, reduced their footprint and kept map previews behind editor overlays.
Kept focus and caret position stable while editing grass, surf, tree and fishing encounter tables.
Made Tab and Shift Tab select complete short-field values without selecting entire script or dialogue editors.
Fixed large NPC sprite previews and recovered selector state after scrolling, history changes and reopening.
Refreshed edited portrait choices and dismissed stale palette editors after Undo, reload or context changes.
Hid optional Claude and built-in emulator controls while retaining their implementations and external emulator access.
Made script selections translucent so syntax-coloured text remains readable while highlighted.
Reserved scrollbar space so hovering cannot cover event arrows, tiles or other editor controls.
Replaced accidental Command-scroll resizing with minus/plus controls and a size indicator.
Restored existing menus for tabs, warps, map arrows, hex content and palettes using Mac secondary-click conventions.
Replaced Windows file-location launching with Finder reveal for the owning ROM file.
Made Play launch a selected external emulator such as mGBA, remembering its application path and supporting Browse.
Kept Command copy, cut and paste on the focused text or palette target instead of falling through to binary editing.
Kept Delete, Backspace and arrow keys inside focused map-event fields instead of deleting or panning the event.
Made Control-click sample sprite colors and block tiles without entering the painting path.
Restored propagation of named swatch colors and hexadecimal color edits into palette data.
Removed the cold-map UI-thread error and focus-outline animation crash.
Fixed rotated map arrows and restored specialized trainer, sprite and palette templates.
Focused the search field after Command-G, including after opening a ROM or changing tabs.
Added Option-drag panning that preserves the current brush and finishes correctly when Option is released first.
Restored Mac Control-drag selection of placed blocks while preserving their collision and elevation data through saves and history.
Added a translucent preview of the selected block pattern at its stamp destination.
Corrected Mac help for Command-click bag membership, clearing the bag and activating random painting.
Preserved movement permissions during bag flood-fill and single-block rectangle painting.
Restored the script-creation button so an object can receive an allocated starter script and attached pointer.
Eliminated complex hover-preview flicker and refreshed summaries after dialogue edits, Undo and Redo.
Stopped ghost painting and panning after capture loss, and kept interrupted strokes separate in Undo history.
Allowed painting, brush replacement and permission changes at the same cell after Undo or Redo.
Cleared transient Space reveal when keyboard focus, tabs or editing contexts change.
Added centered minus and plus buttons that use the existing zoom levels and disable at their limits.
Displayed map size in tiles, native pixel dimensions on hover and clearly labeled cursor coordinates in the status bar.
Saved map images to MapImages beside the ROM with Overwrite, Save Updated Copy and Cancel choices for existing files.
Added a bounded pre-placement sprite picker that remembers its independent choice and toolbar icon for the open ROM session.
Kept blockset previews within the map viewport and limited standalone rendering to valid block counts.
Fixed the map-header dropdown crash while preserving immediate pointer writes, fresh previews and Undo/Redo.
Rejected invalid border coordinates before calculating ROM addresses to protect neighboring data.
Applied explicit movement-permission choices to both inferred and fallback brush corners.
Gave Block ID a fixed position beside Edit Block without overlapping movement controls.
Kept flip arrows visible and clickable while crossing the gap beside each block quadrant.
Refreshed conditional map-script rows after adding or deleting entries while preserving Undo/Redo.
Displayed the saved filename and folder in a compact confirmation with Reveal in Finder and OK actions.
Inserted an automatic text pointer and complete dialogue block with the caret ready for typing.
Added complete movement blocks for player, camera, NPC and applymovement commands when the required operands are available.
Ran dialogue and movement assistance after accepting a command suggestion as well as typing the command directly.
Restored existing unused-ID helper buttons and Command U routing for eligible flag and variable commands.
Corrected caret mapping and command replacement across multiline scripts while preserving explicit hexadecimal values.
Made overflow warnings and script errors visibly underline the affected text without adding popups or automatic wrapping.
Fixed mouse acceptance and dismissed stale suggestions after outside clicks, focus changes, detachment or context replacement.
Corrected trainer move-token validation and warning spans while preserving existing matching and legality rules.
Added a separate Map View with panning, zoom and an optional light tile grid while keeping tiles uneditable.
Opened object, script-event and script-signpost code from Map View while protecting incomplete drafts.
Displayed Object ID and assigned Flag or none for objects, plus Variable Number for script events.
Stopped viewport jumps caused by focus changes and delayed compilation refreshing another script section.
Selected only the first dialogue block when entering through a signpost arrow, with ordinary clicks clearing selection.
Handled typed and accepted commands, trailing whitespace and earlier pointer edits without overwriting explicit addresses.
Updated flag and variable availability after edits, deletion and history changes while retaining protected reservations.
Added a six-pixel advisory cushion to dialogue warnings without changing text encoding or inserting breaks.
Kept accepted movement suggestions closed and prevented truncation markers from entering source.
Staged file replacements and preserved open unsaved documents when ROM or metadata saving fails.
Validated patch structure and UPS checksums before changing ROM bytes, preserving existing edits after rejected IPS or UPS imports.
Rejected incompatible layouts, invalid values and lossy text before applying edits, with rollback if an import fails.
Published consistent table exports with owned-file manifests, writer coordination and recovery from interrupted publication.
Handled replacement and rapid external saves more reliably while protecting local unsaved work.
Bound deferred edits to their original context and accounted for pending source during Save, Save As, Close and reload.
Rolled back failed script and resource compilation across bytes, pointers, relocation, metadata and history while retaining drafts and diagnostics.
Pointed crash/help links and compatible-release checks at the renamed Mac Edition repository while retaining upstream references where appropriate.
Kept referenced scripts separate across unknown byte gaps instead of emitting uncompilable raw FF source.
Updated script-bearing signpost targets when entry code moves, including failure rollback and exact Undo/Redo.
Cleared an owned rejected-draft warning after correction without clearing newer or unrelated errors.
Preserved unusual recent-file names and restored search limits independently of diff limits.
Handled settings-access failures and rejected invalid ROM metadata without aborting startup.
Built architecture-specific app bundles without deleting the last successful output when packaging fails.
Prepared a disabled-until-ready action that validates the English FireRed 1.1 base and creates a separate patched ROM.
Passed 81 groups and 24,292 assertions with zero failures and zero skipped groups in the November 8 complete Mac run.
Expanded synthetic UI coverage for gestures, clipboard routing, suggestions, image previews, persistence and history.
Enabled the original unit and integration test hosts on Mac with explicit optional-ROM skips and recorded legacy expectation differences.
Passed seven related groups and 1,024 assertions for the subsequent font-control change without claiming another complete-suite run.
Recorded source-install and helper-package rehearsals plus a checklist separating completed checks from distribution gates.
Kept fixes and investigation evidence in separate commits with documented checkpoint tags for later review or rollback.
Reduced the recorded 2,000-line highlighting workload from about 197 to 7.8 ms and temporary allocation from 21.6 to 3.3 MB per edit.
Reduced a 2,000-command deferred update from 2,795 to 90 ms in the repeated-argument benchmark.
Coalesced ten queued width calculations into one, reducing the measured 500-line burst from 39.6 to 3.3 ms.
Reduced empty-tile lookup on the 32-NPC fixture from about 4.51 to 0.065 ms by avoiding unrelated event-editor construction.
Removed all 70 unnecessary bitmap publications in the zoom-only benchmark while preserving rendered pixels.
Reduced the measured binding and layout time for 100 complex navigation switches from 924 to 675 ms.
Reduced 100 candidate-preparation operations from 77.4 to about 3.0 ms while preserving image freshness.
Reduced validation of 100 six-member custom teams from 83.1 to 15.0 ms.
Reduced a measured delayed map-usage query from 225 to 148-160 ms by reusing script outcomes within that query.
Reduced settled managed heap from 225.7 to 61.2 MiB in Hex mode and 212.1 to 62.3 MiB in the paired Map tab-switch workload.
Reduced initialization from about 1,342 to 4.6 ms and post-edit refresh from 607 to 2.2 ms in the synthetic shared-tail workload.
